files.title: Barranquilla - Detrás de la Caja Agraria (2008)
files.author: Jdvillalobos

notes: Both verified as the Edificio de la Caja Agraria, centro de Barranquilla (1961 competition-winning tower by Fernando Martínez Sanabria). photo-1: rear/side view showing the famous blind wall clad in abstract stone-relief panels rising over the plaza, PLUS at left edge the ribbed concrete flank of the tower with horizontal slab bands. photo-2: fuller frontal view of the same relief blind wall over the paved plaza with lamp posts. LIMITATION: no free photograph of the main entrance façade on Paseo de Bolívar exists on Wikimedia Commons — both photos document the sculpted party/blind wall and partial side elevations only. The rooftop series ('Barranquilla desde la azotea de la Caja Agraria') was considered but rejected: views FROM the building's roof of the city, not of the building itself.
